question: the black dashed line a selected automated headquarters draws on the map: what builds it, when, from what, and how it is drawn

addresses.name: FrontManager_Load
addresses.comment: **What the front line is drawn with.** The in-game screen's constructor makes the 0x40-byte FrontManager, stores it at CInGameIdler +0x1DDC and calls this (0x64936F); the console's `reloadfx front` calls it again (0x43BA4F). Keeps the graphics at +0x38; CreateVertexDeclaration (device slot 86) of FrontVertexDecl_Elements into +0x20, FatalExit on failure with 'CreateVertexDeclaration failed!! (FrontVertexDecl)'; the effect `/FX/front.fx` by the game's directory settings (key `Front`, FxHandler_Reload then FxHandler_Register, the handler at graphics +0x6BCFC) into +0x24; effect handles WorldViewProjectionMatrix +0x28, CameraPosition +0x2C, ArrowTexture +0x34 and technique `Front` +0x30; the texture `/mapitems/front_arrow.tga` through the texture handler at graphics +0x158 into +0x3C (the install ships it as gfx/mapitems/front_arrow.dds). Two callers. `ret 8`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read whole in the listing, 0x8456E0 to the `ret 8` at 0x845B55. Wrong if the stores at +0x20/+0x24/+0x28.. were a different object's: they run off the [ebp+8] pointer the constructor just stored at +0x1DDC.

addresses.name: FrontManager_BuildForUnit
addresses.comment: **Makes the front line of one unit's plan: the chains of foreign-province borders along its operations area.** First drops the unit's old meshes (FrontManager_RemoveUnit). Then, from CUnit +0x214 (plan.ops_area, CMapProvince* in list order; nothing where the count +0x21C is 0): for each province counts the edges to a neighbour that is land (template +0x22), controlled by another country, and with no co-belligerence (+0x58), alliance (+0x14) or vassal link either way in the owner's status towards it - an 'open' edge. Then chains: passes through the list, starting a new chain at the first province with an open edge; a province is taken only if adjacent to the one before it in the chain, and steps along its open edges where each next neighbour is adjacent to the last, recording {own province, the C index at which it joined} and the neighbours; a pass that adds no point stops. FrontChains_MergePass runs until it merges nothing. Each chain then makes points: for each own province, for each neighbour from its start index minus one, the middle of the two provinces' bounding-box centres (template +0x2C, +0x30) - so the line runs between province centres and **no border pixel is ever read**. 2+ points: FrontLine_Relax, FrontLine_CutCorners, a new MeshBuffer pushed with the unit on the manager's two vectors, FrontManager_MakeMesh. `ret 8`. One caller, CInGameIdler::ShowSelection (0x668BCE), for each of the player's units with an AI agent in its chain that is selected and whose ops area is not empty. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, sections 2 and 3.
addresses.evidence: Read in the decompiler and against the listing, 0x845B60 to the `ret 8` at 0x846D46; the list is the unit's plan at +0x1FC by the gate in ShowSelection and the +0x214/+0x21C offsets. Wrong if an edge test were omitted; the two tests of the country status were compared site by site (0x845CD0.. and 0x846290..).

addresses.name: FrontManager_RemoveUnit
addresses.comment: Drops a unit's front meshes. For i from 0 to the count taken at entry (no bound on what the vector does in between): where units[i] is the unit, units[i] = the last, pop; the mesh at meshes[i] Released (vertex buffer, index buffer, +8) and freed, and meshes[i] = the last, pop. The element swapped into i is not looked at again. `ret 4`. Called by FrontManager_BuildForUnit first, by FrontManager_Prune, and by CGameState::RemoveUnit (0x684E82). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x848180 to its `ret 4`, ESI at each of the three call sites holds the manager. Wrong if the two vectors were not parallel: both are indexed by the same i.

addresses.name: FrontManager_Prune
addresses.comment: Each frame before the screen updates (0x64FBBB, in the idler's update): every entry whose unit is no longer selected (CUnit +0x4 clear) or has no AI agent left in its chain (CUnit +0x198, up +0x1E0, highest wins) is removed through FrontManager_RemoveUnit and its index tried again. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x848280 to the `ret` at 0x8482E8; manager in EAX at the one call site. Wrong if +0x4 were not is_selected: the same byte gates the build in ShowSelection.

addresses.name: FrontManager_Draw
addresses.comment: **Draws every front mesh, each frame.** Called once by CInGameIdler_Render straight after MapGraphics_DrawScene (0x65705C), inside the device-ready branch, gated only by the manager's existence; nothing where the graphics have no current view (+0x6BC88). ZWRITEENABLE 0, ZENABLE 0 (not restored); no height test, no map mode, no layer mask, no setting. SetTechnique(Front); WorldViewProjectionMatrix = view x projection of the current view's camera (slots 91, 93); CameraPosition = camera +0x33C (x, y) by SetFloatArray of 2; SetVertexDeclaration(+0x20); ArrowTexture from the texture handler entry +0x3C. For each pass: BeginPass, CommitChanges, VertexBuffer_Draw for each mesh in meshes; EndPass, End. **Once only: the hierarchy lines' second draw a map width over is not done here**, so no wrap at the seam. `ret 8`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x8482F0 to the `ret 8`; the one caller, and its gate at 0x657056 (cmp to 0). Wrong if a height or mask test sat in the render routine above the call: the call is in the same block as DrawScene's.

addresses.name: FrontManager_MakeMesh
addresses.signature: void __stdcall FrontManager_MakeMesh(FrontManager* manager, MeshBuffer* mesh, void* points)
addresses.comment: **A polyline made into a strip.** n points, 2n vertices of 0x10 bytes (float2 position, float2 uv), (n-1) x 6 16-bit indices (i, i+1, i+2; i+1, i+3, i+2 from i = 0 by twos), a managed pool, no FVF and no declaration on the mesh. Each point i below n-1: normal(i) = (-dy, dx) / length of the segment i to i+1 (a pair of slots: the first segment's normal seeds slot 1, so point 0 uses it twice); miter = (normal(i-1) + normal(i)) normalised; vertex 2i = P[i] + miter x 3.0, uv (s, 0); vertex 2i+1 = P[i] + miter x -3.0, uv (s, 1) (DAT_0171DBAC, 1.0), where s = the running sum of the segment lengths starting at 0. Last point: the last segment's normal unaveraged, uv (total length, 0 and 1). `ret 0xc`. No province, no border and no terrain data; the points are all it reads. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole in the listing and decompiler, 0x847C50 to the end; 0x160A4E8 is 3.0 and 0x160A9B8 is -3.0 in the image. Wrong if the slot pairing mixed normals: the slot index is (i & 1) and the sum is of both slots.

addresses.name: FrontChains_MergePass
addresses.comment: **One pass of joining the front's chains.** chains is a std::vector of 0x38-byte FrontChain. For each ordered pair R, S of non-empty chains, in eight tests in this order - ends sharing a province with their neighbours adjacent, or ends' provinces adjacent with one neighbour shared - S is appended to R, R or S reversed first as the matching ends need, and S's province list emptied; then every chain with an empty province list is erased, newest first. Answers whether one was erased; FrontManager_BuildForUnit repeats until it answers false. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 2.5.
addresses.evidence: Every branch read in the listing; the reversal targets (EDI at each call of 0x845540) read at their sites. Wrong if the eight cases overlapped differently: the comparisons are in the fixed order given.

addresses.name: FrontLine_Relax
addresses.comment: Two passes, factor 1.0 then 0.5, over a front polyline's points in place: unit directions of its segments, then for i from 2 up to n-3 P[i] += (d[i] - d[i-1]) x factor. The first two and last two points never move. Nothing for fewer than 5 points. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x8484C0 to the `ret` at 0x8489A4; the decompiler drops the loop ('unreachable') so the listing is the source. The factor halving is the mulsd by 0.5 at 0x848971.

addresses.name: FrontLine_CutCorners
addresses.comment: **One round of Chaikin corner cutting**: output[0] = input[0]; for i in 1..n-2 two points 0.25 x P[i-1] + 0.75 x P[i] and 0.75 x P[i] + 0.25 x P[i+1]; the last output = the last input. 2n-2 points. One round, for every chain, by FrontManager_BuildForUnit. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the constants 0.25 and 0.75 at 0x160A258 and 0x160A638. The one call site passes the input in ECX and the output's address in EAX.

addresses.name: FrontChain_Append
addresses.comment: Appends a front chain's provinces and neighbours to another's, and its start indices after the first, each shifted by the neighbours the chain already held. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 2.5.
addresses.evidence: Read whole. Both call sites load EDI with S and push R.

addresses.name: FrontChain_Reverse
addresses.comment: Reverses a front chain in place: its provinces, neighbours and start indices (the last b becoming neighbours - b + 1). Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 2.5.
addresses.evidence: Read whole. The target is whatever EDI is at each site; both R and S occur.

addresses.name: FrontVertexDecl_Elements
addresses.comment: The front line's D3DVERTEXELEMENT9 list, static in .data: {stream 0, offset 0, FLOAT2, DEFAULT, POSITION 0}, {0, 8, FLOAT2, DEFAULT, TEXCOORD 0}, D3DDECL_END - front.fx's VS_INPUT, a 16-byte vertex. Its one reference is FrontManager_Load's CreateVertexDeclaration.
addresses.evidence: Bytes read: 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 / 00 00 08 00 01 00 05 00 / FF 00 00 00 11 00 00 00. Wrong if the layout differed from VS_INPUT in gfx/FX/front.fx.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::ShowSelection
addresses.comment: Slot 32. Clears what the last selection drew on the map - the markers of an AI's objectives, the arrows - and, for a unit of the player's, **gives its two counters their ring: 1, white, or 2, the counter type's color1, where an AI agent commands the unit or one above it**; then, **where unit is not null and is the player's and an AI agent commands it or one above it, walks every unit of the player's country and for each with an agent in its chain: FrontManager_BuildForUnit where that unit is selected and its plan has an ops area (a unit under an agent included), the objective markers MapObjective, MapObjectiveOther where it is not the unit shown, and AutomationArrow or OtherAutomationArrow along the plan's path where it is land and its army role is 0.** A null unit builds nothing and touches no front mesh. Callers: CObjectivesEntry's constructor (unit where an agent commands it, null otherwise), CObjectivesEntry::OnAutomateChecked (unit on ticking, null on unticking), CSetPlanOpsAreaCommand::Execute and the toggle and axis commands, CInGameIdler::RemoveUnitRow (null). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-hierarchy.md, section 6, and FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Comment only: adds the front build and the callers, read in the decompiler; the signature and name are unchanged. The rings stand as FINDINGS-hierarchy.md had them. Wrong if a caller that passes a unit was missed: the scan for mov reg,[reg+0x80]; call reg found 14 reads of the in-game screen's slot 32, listed in the findings, and could not see one not reached through +0xBE8 or the idler itself.

structs.name: FrontManager
structs.comment: **Our name** - the game's string says 'Front manager error' and nothing else; no vftable and no RTTI. What the front lines are drawn from: two parallel vectors (one chain = one mesh, several chains per unit possible), and the D3D objects of front.fx. Made by the in-game screen's constructor, held at CInGameIdler +0x1DDC. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md.
structs.evidence: operator new(0x40) at 0x649332, the constructor's zeroes, the +0x38/+0x3C/+0x34.. uses in FrontManager_Load and _Draw.

structs.name: FrontChain
structs.comment: **Our name.** One chain of a front while it is being built: three std::vector<int> and a trailing eight bytes moved but not read. provinces (own province ids, in order), starts (for each own province the C index where its neighbours start, plus a final sentinel; the first entry is forced to 1), neighbours. Local to FrontManager_BuildForUnit, gone when it returns.
structs.evidence: Stride 0x38 of the vector at [ebp-0xA8] (0x848A60/0x848D70, 0x847B8C's arithmetic); vector layout from the push paths at +0, +0x10, +0x20. The +0x30 pair is copied in 0x848CA0 and otherwise untouched.

struct_fields.name: front_manager
struct_fields.comment: The manager of the front lines an automated headquarters shows, made by the constructor. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md.
struct_fields.evidence: Stored at 0x649369 from the new; read in ShowSelection (0x668BAC), CInGameIdler_Render (0x657050) and the prune's caller.

struct_fields.name: units_begin
struct_fields.comment: std::vector of the units the meshes belong to; a unit appears once per chain it drew.
struct_fields.evidence: push_back at 0x846C2E with EDI on the manager; RemoveUnit's search.

struct_fields.name: meshes_begin
struct_fields.comment: std::vector of one MeshBuffer per chain, parallel to units.
struct_fields.evidence: push_back at 0x846C39; FrontManager_Draw's loop; RemoveUnit's parallel swap.

struct_fields.name: vertex_declaration
struct_fields.comment: IDirect3DVertexDeclaration9* of FrontVertexDecl_Elements, set on the device by FrontManager_Draw.

struct_fields.name: texture_index
struct_fields.comment: The texture handler's index of mapitems/front_arrow.tga, read as hierarchy's is (index x 0x2C + 0x15C of the graphics).

struct_fields.name: provinces_begin
struct_fields.evidence: the store of the province id at 0x84666E and 0x8466BF

struct_fields.name: starts_begin
struct_fields.comment: For each own province the neighbours index where its own start, then a final sentinel; [0] is forced to 1.
struct_fields.evidence: The stores at 0x84672E and 0x84677F, the end sentinel before 0x84689C, and the store of 1 into the first at 0x84689C.

struct_fields.name: neighbours_begin
struct_fields.comment: Foreign neighbour province ids, in the order walked.
struct_fields.evidence: The end pointer read at 0x84638D and the pushes of the taken neighbour's id after it.
